title: Conditional machine head positions
statement: Given finite Boolean Turing machines $D$, $M_1$, and $M_2$, head-position assignments $d$ for the $D$ tapes and $b$ for the combined $M_1$ and $M_2$ tapes, and an integer $z$, define head positions for all tapes of the timed conditional machine by using $d$ on the first block, $b$ on the next block, and $z$ on the final extra tape.
hypotheses_covered: $D$, $M_1$, and $M_2$ are finite Boolean Turing machines
$d$ assigns integer positions to the $D$ work tapes
$b$ assigns integer positions to the combined $M_1$ and $M_2$ work tapes
